reason: Screens and components drew backend or contract states as UI. Approved for deletion; deleted in Figma on 2026-10-15.
policy: The October 15 removal deleted screens and components that drew backend or contract states as UI: the auth state machine, cancellation races, request reconciliation, cross-tab submission and guest-draft ownership. Do not redraw them. Their behavior stays in backend contracts and tests; only the requirement for a dedicated UI surface is retired. The real client surfaces are AuthGateDialog "Sign in to continue", the RequireAuth redirect to /signin, the AccountPopover and toasts.
